cases.name: the example
cases.cmd: "$BIN" f.txt 3; for k in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do if [ -f f.txt.part$k ]; then echo "== f.txt.part$k"; cat f.txt.part$k; fi; done; echo "$(ls | wc -l) files"
cases.stdout:
f.txt.part1: 3 lines
f.txt.part2: 3 lines
f.txt.part3: 1 lines
== f.txt.part1
1
2
3
== f.txt.part2
4
5
6
== f.txt.part3
7
4 files
